## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. Fork A: the feed honours the object-level declaration. No new key

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T15:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why A, without the decision box:** `ObjectSchema.managedBy: 'platform'` already declares "Generic New / Import / Edit / Delete affordances are all shown", and it names `sys_comment` as its example. The data layer lets an author update and delete their own comment. So the record feed is withholding a declared affordance. Fixing that adds no key (`Clause-②: no`). B's new `RecordActivityProps` key would widen the spec for something already declared.
- **Why p3:** users cannot edit or delete their own comments, and no data is wrong.
- **Direction:**
  - The record feed offers edit and delete on the author's own comment, reusing `@object-ui/collaboration`'s owner-gated implementation. ⛔ No second owner rule.
  - The server's rule stays the authority, and a refusal surfaces as an error.
  - Delete goes through the console's ordinary destructive-action confirm.
  - The dev measures whether the server stamps `is_edited` / `edited_at`. If it does, the client ⛔ does not stamp them.
  - Pins:
    - an author edits and deletes their own comment;
    - another user sees neither control;
    - an edited comment reads as edited.
- **Delivery:** reaches hosted HotCRM with cloud's v18 framework move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709).
- Triage: lands in the record feed (`packages/plugin-detail` / `app-shell`, `domain:ui`); rationale: a declared affordance the feed withholds.

Claim: PM loop round 2 (triage `6127815908`: fork A, the record feed honours `managedBy: 'platform'`'s declared Edit / Delete on the author's own comment, ⛔ no new spec key)
Session: `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12268`

File surface: the record feed's comment rows and the host handlers that reach them, read on objectui `main` `5dcb101` at 2026-10-12T16:05Z (stop on breach; explain in the report):
- **The feed:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` (the comment row's controls) and `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx` / `record-chatter.tsx` (they take write handlers off the host `DiscussionContext`).
- **The host:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, which builds the `DiscussionContext` value and owns the `sys_comment` read and writes; and `packages/react/src/context/DiscussionContext.tsx`, the context's type.
- **The owner rule, reused:** `@object-ui/collaboration`'s `CommentThread` owner gate (inline in that component today). `plugin-detail` does not depend on `@object-ui/collaboration` (its `package.json`, read on `main`); the dev measures how to reuse the one rule without a second copy.
- Co-located tests, and `.changeset/12268-feed-comment-edit-delete.md`.
- ⛔ No new spec key or `RecordActivityProps` member. ⛔ No second owner rule. ⛔ No client-side stamp of `is_edited` / `edited_at` if the server stamps them (the dev measures).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: the edit and delete handlers must reach the feed through a published TypeScript surface, either `@object-ui/react`'s `DiscussionContext` value type or `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s exported `RecordActivityTimelineProps`, so a new member there widens the published surface. No spec key is added; triage's `Clause-②: no` reads the spec, this line reads the package entries. Declared `yes` before the route is chosen; an at-tier contract review is owed before the queue.
Responsibility: `objectui's record feed (plugin-detail RecordActivityTimeline, hosted by app-shell RecordDetailView), which renders no edit or delete on the author's own comment | the platform already declares it (spec ObjectSchema.managedBy 'platform', naming sys_comment) and holds it (plugin-audit comment-access-hooks: authors govern their own words) | every author of a record comment; measured on hosted HotCRM 4.0.1 (CASE-00041, KA-0005, 2 of 2)`
Thread-read: 6127815908
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T16:05Z on objectui `main` `5dcb101`. This seat's objectui#12244 (PR objectui#12266, `RecordDetailView.tsx`) and objectui#12249 (PR objectui#12267) have both landed, so no holder remains on these files. The three open non-release PRs (objectui#12253, #12262, #12263) touch none of the files above. Seat 2 holds only the split parent objectui#12211.

## Seat verdict: REWORK (patch round 1) on objectui PR #12269 at `50c82f9` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-12T17:20Z

Reviewed on GitHub against the claim `6127978495` and triage `6127815908`, not against the report `6129076734`. One blocking item. Everything else checked out, and is recorded below so the patch round re-earns only that item.

### Blocking: deleting a comment hides other users' replies

This PR is the first console path that deletes a comment, so this is a defect it makes reachable, and it is fixed here rather than noted.
- `handleDeleteComment` removes only the deleted row from the record's feed slice.
- With threading on, `RecordActivityTimeline`'s `rootItems` drops every item that has a `parentId`, and `repliesByParent` is only ever read for parents present in the feed.
- So once an author deletes a comment that has replies, every reply to it (another user's included) silently disappears from the record page, both at once and after a reload. Nothing says they still exist.
- The PR's own Acceptance notes describe this ("shows them under nothing"), as platform policy.

**Asked:**
- With threading on, a reply whose `parentId` names no item the feed holds renders as a root row, in its place in the feed.
- Pin it through the host on both feed blocks: an author deletes their comment that carries another user's reply, the reply stays visible, and it stays visible after the feed is read again. Prove the pin with an ablation leg.
- ⛔ No client rule about which comments may be deleted, and no cascade from the client. Whether a parent's delete removes its replies is the platform's call, and the server stays the authority (Zone 1).
- Add one sentence to the changeset, and report the new head with the re-run gate union.

### Checked and accepted (not re-reviewed unless the patch touches it)

- **PR form.** Draft, base `main`, assignee `zhuangjianguo`. Line 1 is `Fixes #12268`, line 2 is `Clause-②: yes`, and that is the body's only closing keyword. `needs:contract-review` is hung. `check-governed-merges --pr` reads NOT governed, 1409 lines.
- **Ruling fences held.**
  - One owner rule: `isCommentAuthor`, read by `CommentThread` and by the page per `sys_comment` row. The feed reads only the host's `authoredByViewer`.
  - The `sys_comment` read sends no `$expand`, and `author_id` is written as `currentUser.id` on create, so the two ids are in one space.
  - Delete goes through the page's existing `confirmHandler` / `ActionConfirmDialog`, painted destructive.
  - No spec key is added.
- **Client stamp.** Read on objectstack `origin/main`: `sys-comment.object.ts` declares `is_edited` / `edited_at` as plain, writable fields, and no hook stamps them. The ruling's second branch therefore applies, and the client write is accepted by the server.
- **Published surface.** It matches the body's "Published surface" list, and every member is new and optional. The `minor` level fits widening; there is no `major`.
- **Changeset and docs.** Both read sentence by sentence against the diff: the Edit, Delete and permission sentences, the published-surface bullets, the docs paragraph and the three prop tables.

### Claim amendment (file surface)

The claim's surface is amended to the widened set the report's `deviations` explain, each forced by a measurement:
- `packages/types/src/views.ts` (`FeedItem` carried no author id);
- `packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts` and `packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (the write census);
- `packages/collaboration/src/commentAuthorship.ts` and `index.ts` (the one exported rule);
- `plugin-detail` `CommentAuthorControls.tsx`, `ThreadedReplies.tsx`, `RecordChatterPanel.tsx` and `useDetailTranslation.ts`;
- the ten language packs, and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`.

No open PR touches any of them (objectui#12253, #12262 and #12263 read at this verdict).

### Acceptance notes, triaged

- **No server stamp of `is_edited` / `edited_at`:** stays an Acceptance note. Carrier: the next objectstack change to `comment-access-hooks.ts`. It is not measured through a public door, so the filing gate's `reach:` is unmet.
- **The `canStoreReaction` stale docblock:** a code comment only, so no card.
- **The orphan-reply note:** promoted to the blocking item above.

### Next

The same dev, patch round 1. After the new head, the seat reviews the delta, then runs the at-tier contract review this `Clause-②: yes` card owes before the queue.
